battle.name: 居魯士大帝戰爭
battle.brief: 公元前553年起，安山之王居魯士以西部行省與伊奧尼亞的起義為突破口，滅米底、臣呂底、破埃蘭，在底格里斯河畔的奧帕斯擊潰新巴比倫大軍，巴比倫隨之陷落。卡面的亞述長矛是九世紀亞述步兵的短柄鐵矛，形制雖已讓位於波斯長矛與柳條大盾，它遺下的鐵匠與工兵傳統，卻是居魯士攻城奪城倚賴的底子。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 這場戰爭打了十四年，交戰方從西南方的伊奧尼亞一路換到東南方的兩河流域，先後有六方捲入。波斯一方以安山與波斯之王居魯士二世為核心，兵力由波斯與米底步兵、薩迦弓手、阿拉伯與卡里亞的徵召兵組成，國王近衛為骨幹：希羅多德記載居魯士有一萬名「不死軍」與六千騎兵。御道沿線的驛站、倉儲與數千工匠隊隨軍同行，這才是波斯能連續遠征的真正底子。米底一方以埃克巴塔那為都，末代王阿斯提亞格斯倚仗草原騎兵，境內阿利卡尼人、阿扎提人、布薩人、馬吉人、莫納德斯人各成軍隊，另有各行省徵召的步兵。新巴比倫由末代王納波尼德與王子貝爾沙爾主持，祭司集團掌總廟埃薩吉拉與伊什塔爾門，城防軍與集結在斯帕爾的野戰軍分駐兩處。埃蘭由國王特烏曼、其子坦馬里圖與烏馬尼什領銜，據薩西斯與胡齊斯坦低地。呂底王克洛伊斯先與米底結盟，後在廷布拉敗於波斯。伊奧尼亞方面則由米利都的阿里斯塔戈拉與希斯提亞斯率十二座城邦的聯軍，備重裝方陣與艦隊。第三方各有所圖：呂基亞與塞浦路斯供應船隻，斯巴達完全按兵不動，雅典只遣一艘船去尼亞克索斯。
countriesEn: This war ran for fourteen years, and the opposing side changed from the Ionian coast in the south-west all the way to the Mesopotamian river plains in the south-east, with six parties drawn into it in all. On the Persian side the core was Cyrus II of Anshan and Persia, with an army built out of Persian and Median infantry, Sagarch archers, and levies from Arabia and Caria, all built around the royal guard: Herodotus records that Cyrus had ten thousand Immortals and six thousand cavalry. The staging posts, depots and several thousand engineers of the royal road travelled with the army, and that was the real foundation of Persian campaigning. The Median side had its capital at Ecbatana; the last king, Astyages, relied on the grassland cavalry, and within Media the Aricani, Azati, Busae, Magi and Monades each raised their own contingents, supplemented by levies from the provinces. Neo-Babylon was run by the last king Nabonidus and the crown prince Belshazzar, with the priestly group in charge of the great temple Esagila and the Ishtar Gate; the garrison inside the walls and the field army assembled at Sippar were stationed in two separate places. Elam was led by the king Teumman, his son Tammar and Umanish, holding Susa and the lowlands of Khuzistan. Croesus, king of Lydia, first allied with Media and was later defeated by Persia at Timbra. On the Ionian side Aristagoras and Histiaeus of Miletus led a league of twelve cities with a phalanx of armoured infantry and a fleet. Third parties each had their own game: Lycia and Cyprus supplied ships, Sparta stood entirely still, and Athens sent a single ship to Naxos.
people: 居魯士二世是這場戰爭唯一貫穿到底的主導者。他是安山之王坎巴西斯一世與米底王阿斯提亞格斯之女曼達妮所生，按波斯與米底的傳說，他一出生就被外祖父判了死罪，是牧童米特拉達忒斯與他的母羊救下了他；坎巴西斯後來被米底祭司所殺，安山人擁立居魯士，並以「波斯與米底的王位應歸於一人」的聯姻理由起兵反抗阿斯提亞格斯。他先取埃克巴塔那滅米底，再收呂底王克洛伊斯、破埃蘭、攻巴比倫，於前539年入主兩河。哈帕古斯是居魯士最倚重的將領，滅呂底、掃平西部行省，後因謀反被誅。阿斯提亞格斯失位後被米底貴族殺害，其女曼達妮即居魯士之母於其後不久病逝。克洛伊斯被俘後不但未受苛待，反而因熟悉商務與農政而成為居魯士的顧問，後世把他與國王的對答寫成盛時當思衰的箴言。巴比倫方面的納波尼德把王室與宗教事業的重心放在阿拉伯沙漠的泰瑪，自前545年才返回巴比倫；貝爾沙爾代父守城，未能組織有效的抵抗。埃蘭的特烏曼、坦馬里圖與烏馬尼什在會戰中被俘。巴比倫北方的王古布里亞斯在奧帕斯大敗之後，反被居魯士任為巴比倫總督。史料作者彼此牴觸：希羅多德詳於呂底戰事與居魯士的仁慈，克西提亞斯記埃蘭戰役的殘酷，色諾芬把攻城寫成奇襲，貝羅索斯則以巴比倫祭司的立場補上神像被搬走的記錄。
peopleEn: Cyrus II is the one figure who runs through this war from beginning to end. He was the son of Cambyses I of Anshan and Mandane, a daughter of the Median king Astyages; Persian and Median tradition holds that he was sentenced to death on the day he was born and was saved by the shepherd Mithradates and his ewe. Cambyses was afterwards murdered by magi, the Anshan people raised Cyrus in his place, and they gave as their reason for the revolt that the crowns of Persia and Media belonged in one pair of hands, through Cyrus and Mandane. He took Ecbatana and ended the Median kingdom, then took Croesus of Lydia, broke Elam and struck at Babylon, entering the river lands in 539 BC. Harpagus was the commander he relied on most, reducing Lydia and sweeping the western provinces, and he was later put to death for plotting against Cyrus. After his fall Astyages was killed by Median nobles, and his daughter Mandane, Cyrus's mother, died of illness shortly afterwards. Croesus, once captured, was not ill treated; his knowledge of trade and agriculture made him a counsellor to Cyrus, and later generations turned his exchanges with the king into a warning against over-confidence in prosperity. On the Babylonian side Nabonidus had moved the centre of court and religious business to Tema in the Arabian desert and did not return to Babylon until 545 BC; Belshazzar held the city in his father's place but could not organise effective resistance. The Elamite Teumman, Tammar and Umanish were taken prisoner after the decisive battle. The ancient authors disagree with one another: Herodotus is generous about Croesus and Cyrus's clemency, Ctesias is harsh about the Elamite war, Xenophon turns the siege of Babylon into a night raid, and Berossus, writing as a Babylonian priest, adds what he knows of the removal of the divine images.
kits: 卡面是亞述長矛：約公元前九世紀亞述帝國步兵的制式長矛，短柄長刃，寬闊的葉形鐵矛頭套在木杆上，配一張高及身前的柳條大盾，與弓、短刀同掛一身。亞述人靠這種矛盾結成的密集矛牆，一城一城壓平了兩河流域。但到了居魯士的時代，這件兵器早已退出軍列：亞述帝國在前612年九尼微陷落後崩解，前553年時亞述故地已是米底的一省，亞述城、尼姆魯德、科爾薩巴德一帶的鐵匠鋪仍在打矛頭與箭鏃。波斯步兵真正上手的是更長的長矛、柳條大盾（spadion，後來被希臘人稱為 spara）、附藤牌小盾、鳥首短刀 akinakes、單刃斧 sagaris，以及帶鉸接頰甲的青銅頭盔與複合弓；騎兵配馬刺與手執的柱狀長矛，四馬戰車只在儀仗與追擊中出現。攻城一面是居魯士真正的看家本領：築壩掘渠、引幼發拉底河水入人工河道、築攻城坡道、安放撞木與雲梯，輔以掘壕的工兵隊，參與的工匠以千計。海軍由伊奧尼亞、呂基亞與塞浦路斯的船匠和水手組成，輸送到前552年拉代海戰的戰場。埃蘭軍的長矛、彎刀與輕戰車則是薩西斯一帶的老樣子。運輸靠牛車、駱駝隊與御道驛站接力。
kitsEn: The card shows an Assyrian spear: the standard spear of Assyrian imperial infantry from about the ninth century BC, a short haft carrying a long blade, the broad leaf-shaped iron head socketed onto a wooden shaft, carried together with a tall wicker shield reaching the chest, a bow and a short blade. The Assyrians pressed such a wall of spears forward and took city after city across the two river lands. But by the time of Cyrus this weapon was no longer an issue of equipment: after Nineveh fell in 612 BC the Assyrian state had broken up, and by 553 BC the Assyrian heartland was a province of Media, while the iron workshops of Assur, Nimrud and Khorsabad were still hammering out spearheads and arrowheads. What the Persian infantry actually carried was a longer spear, the tall wicker shield (spadion, later called spara by the Greeks), the small wicker shield of the bowmen, the bird-headed short sword akinakes, the single-bladed axe sagaris, bronze helmets with hinged cheek pieces, and the composite bow. The cavalry carried a spiked arm and the club-like korymbos, and the four-horse chariot appeared only in pageantry and in pursuit. On the siege side lay Cyrus's true speciality: dams and cut channels to divert the Euphrates, siege ramps, battering rams and ladders, with engineer units digging the approach trenches, and the craftsmen involved numbered in the thousands. The navy was built by Ionian, Lycian and Cypriot shipwrights and crews, and it was that navy which fought the battle of Lade in 552 BC. The Elamite long spear, curved sword and light chariot were the old pattern of the Susian plain. Transport depended on ox carts, camel trains and the relay of staging posts along the royal road.
tactics: 波斯的打法是箭矢開路、矛牆定形、騎兵收割。步兵前列以大盾相接、長矛前指，弓箭手居後放箭掩護，國王近衛與不死軍留作總預備隊，直到對手側翼露出缺口才一齊壓上；騎兵集中在右翼衝鋒，退下時以投射武器覆蓋追兵。西線的拉代海戰是另一套邏輯：居魯士以海軍封住海口，誘伊奧尼亞聯隊出港，以多船包抄擊沉，再以陸軍包圍米利都，圍城數年後城破。攻呂底的廷布拉會戰定於前546年5月28日，用的是兩翼迂迴：波斯軍先以正面吸收克洛伊斯的精騎，再令兩翼同時進攻包抄；希羅多德記下當日正逢日蝕，兩軍在黑暗中短兵相接。攻埃蘭則靠兩路會師與封鎖水道，圍而不急攻，以斷糧與斷水迫其出戰，薩西斯一戰全勝，三名首領被俘。決定性的奧帕斯會戰在前539年於底格里斯河中游進行：巴比倫野戰軍列陣於河岸，波斯軍以步兵矛牆接住對方攻勢，隨即以騎兵自側翼插入，河岸一帶陷於混戰，野戰軍潰散，殘部退向斯帕爾。最後是圍巴比倫：波斯人在幼發拉底河上游築壩引水，改變河道，並在城西築坡掘壕，於夜間自水門方向逼近，最後由城內接應者開啟城門，兵不血刃地入城。
tacticsEn: Persian battle method was to open with arrows, fix the shape of the fight with a wall of spears, and reap with the cavalry. The infantry stood with overlapping tall shields and levelled spears in front, the archers loosed from behind them, and the royal guard with the Immortals were held back as general reserve until a gap opened in the enemy flank, at which point the whole line pressed forward; the cavalry massed on the right to charge, and covered the withdrawal with missiles. The battle of Lade in the west followed a different logic: Cyrus sealed the sea lanes with his fleet, tempted the Ionian league out of the harbours, closed on them with more ships than they could match, and then invested Miletus on land; the city fell after a siege of several years. The battle of Timbra against Lydia, fought in 546 BC, used a turning movement on both flanks: the Persian line absorbed the Lydian cavalry head on and then the two wings closed in to envelop them, and Herodotus records that the engagement was fought under a solar eclipse, with the two sides coming to close quarters in the sudden dark. The war against Elam relied on converging columns and on cutting the water supply, besieging rather than storming and forcing the enemy to come out to fight; Susa was taken in a single decisive action, and three leaders were captured. The decisive engagement at Opis was fought in 539 BC on the middle Tigris: the Babylonian field army deployed along the bank, the Persian infantry took the enemy assault on the spear wall, the cavalry then drove in from the flank, and the river bank dissolved into a melee in which the field army broke and its remnants fell back towards Sippar. The siege of Babylon came last: the Persians built a dam upstream on the Euphrates and turned the river into a new channel, raised ramps and trenches on the western side, approached the walls by night from the water gate, and entered when a party inside opened the gates for them.
data: 可核的數字不多，這本身便是重點。時間：戰爭自前553或前552年起，至前539年陷巴比倫止，約十四年；巴比倫編年史把陷城日定在提斯里月十六日，即前539年10月12日；居魯士入巴比倫並在阿基圖祭受冊為巴比倫王，是前538年3月29日，同年稍後再以「萬國之王」的名號加冕。節點：拉代海戰前552；米利都陷落前545或前546；廷布拉會戰前546年5月28日；薩西斯之戰有前540與前538兩說；奧帕斯會戰前539。距離：薩西斯至巴比倫約一千一百至一千二百公里；希羅多德5.52說薩西斯至薩迪斯的御道全程一百一十一日、約二千七百公里；巴比倫至斯帕爾約五十公里；幼發拉底河全長約二千八百公里，底格里斯約一千八百五十公里。城防：巴比倫城牆周長約四十斯塔迪亞，約七點五公里，高約百肘，約五十公尺，幼發拉底河自城中央穿過。兵力：希羅多德與巴比倫編年史都沒有留下可信的交戰人數，他筆下的波斯軍「數十萬」是文學修辭，後人引用的具體數字多屬推估；不死軍一萬、騎兵六千（希羅多德5.66）同樣是他的說法。埃蘭前例：亞述於前585年在烏萊河擊敗埃蘭，前655至647年再度征埃蘭並劫掠薩西斯，前604年的洪水淹浸薩西斯的埃蘭軍營，前612年埃蘭與米底、巴比倫聯軍攻陷九尼微。
dataEn: Few numbers can be verified, and that is itself the point. Dates: the war ran from 553 or 552 BC to the fall of Babylon in 539 BC, about fourteen years; the Babylonian Chronicle dates the fall to the sixteenth of Tishri, that is 12 October 539 BC; Cyrus entered Babylon and was installed as king of Babylon at the Akitu festival on 29 March 538 BC, and later that same year was crowned under the title of king of all lands. Sequence of events: Lade in 552 BC; the fall of Miletus in 545 or 546 BC; the battle of Timbra on 28 May 546 BC, the date fixed by the eclipse; the battle of Susa, which is dated either to 540 BC or to 538 BC; the battle of Opis in 539 BC. Distances: Susa to Babylon about 1,100 to 1,200 kilometres; Herodotus 5.52 gives 111 days, some 2,700 kilometres, for the royal road from Susa to Sardis; Babylon to Sippar about fifty kilometres; the Euphrates about 2,800 kilometres long and the Tigris about 1,850. Defences: the circuit of Babylon's walls is given as about forty stadia, some 7.5 kilometres, with a height of about a hundred cubits, some fifty metres, and the Euphrates running through the middle of the city. Numbers of troops: neither Herodotus nor the Babylonian Chronicle leaves a credible figure for the men engaged, and his Persian host of hundreds of thousands is literary rhetoric whose later arithmetic is guesswork; the ten thousand Immortals and six thousand horsemen of 5.66 are likewise his account. Elamite precedents: Assyria beat Elam at the Ulai in 585 BC, campaigned against Elam again between 655 and 647 BC and sacked Susa, a flood destroyed the Elamite camp at Susa in 604 BC, and in 612 BC an Elamite, Median and Babylonian coalition took Nineveh.
cause: 戰爭是三股力量撞在一起的結果。第一是王位的法理糾葛：坎巴西斯一世死於米底祭司之手，安山人認為阿斯提亞格斯這樣的米底人無權當波斯王，便以居魯士母子的血統為理由起兵；而居魯士年輕時曾被囚禁，也差點在嬰孩時期被外祖父除掉，這兩段記恨把父子兩代都推上戰場。第二是西部同時起火：伊奧尼亞城邦不耐波斯總督的統治，前553年呂底、卡帕多細亞等行省與米利都等城邦同時叛亂，雅典只派一艘船、斯巴達則完全按兵不動，聯軍在拉代海戰崩潰，米利都直到前545年才陷落。這場內亂拖住了波斯王廷的兵馬，也讓居魯士有了接管西部軍權的資本。第三是巴比倫與埃蘭的聯盟：納波尼德把巴比倫諸神的神像運往薩西斯，優容月神辛而冷落馬爾杜克，在阿拉伯的泰瑪一住十二年，並與埃蘭王特烏曼結為同盟；居魯士以「恢復神廟、遣返神像」為旗號，先進攻埃蘭切斷巴比倫的外援，再直取兩河。宗教合法性的競爭，是這場戰爭最深的一層原因。
causeEn: The war came out of three forces colliding. The first was a dispute over the legitimate title to the throne: after Cambyses I was killed by Median magi, the Anshan people held that a Median such as Astyages had no right to be king of Persia, and they rebelled in the name of Cyrus and his mother Mandane; Cyrus himself had been confined and had very nearly been killed as an infant by his maternal grandfather, and these two memories of injury put father and son alike into the field. The second was the conflagration in the west at the same moment: the Ionian cities could no longer bear the Persian satraps, and in 553 BC the satrapies of Lydia and Cappadocia and a dozen Ionian cities rose together, Athens sending a single ship and Sparta nothing at all, only for the league to be shattered at Lade and Miletus to hold out until 545 BC. That rising tied down the Persian court, and it gave Cyrus the means to take over the military command of the western provinces. The third was the alliance of Babylon and Elam: Nabonidus had carried the divine images of Babylon's gods to Susa, favoured the moon god Sin over Marduk, and lived twelve years at Tema in Arabia, while tying himself to the Elamite king Teumman; Cyrus answered by raising the banner of restoring the temples and returning the gods, struck at Elam first to cut Babylon off from outside help, and then went straight for the two rivers. The competition over religious legitimacy was the deepest layer of the whole war.
impact: 這場戰爭之後，亞述、巴比倫、米底、埃蘭四方的舊秩序一次清空，阿契美尼德帝國取而代之，疆域自安納托利亞東抵印度河，以薩西斯為行政首都、波斯波利斯為禮儀首都。居魯士圓柱的銘文宣稱釋放被擄民眾、歸還被掠神像、懲罰克洛伊斯、護持各城神廟，雖是為自身合法性服務的政治文本，卻確實開啟了波斯君主護持異教神廟與寬待被征服者的傳統；前536年馬爾杜克神像自薩西斯迎回埃薩吉拉，兩河祭司集團自此與波斯王權長期合作。制度上，行省總督制、御道與驛站接力（希羅多德5.52描述整條御道上的驛傳接力）、波斯式的方陣與柳條大盾，都被後世希臘與希臘化世界仿效；亞述最後一王阿述爾-烏巴利特二世前609年卒於哈蘭，亞述長矛自此只剩象徵與祖產的份額，亞述人留下的鐵匠與攻城工藝反被波斯收編。代價與未竟之事同樣清楚：被壓迫的行省舊怨未消，埃蘭舊王族前521年在巴比倫起兵即被平定，居魯士本人前530年陣亡於中亞札卜河，波斯的帝國邊界從此推到馬吉安與中亞草原。
impactEn: After this war the old order of Assyria, Babylonia, Media and Elam was cleared away in a single stroke and the Achaemenid Empire took its place, running from Anatolia east to the Indus, with Susa as the administrative capital and Persepolis as the ceremonial one. The Cyrus Cylinder declares the release of captives, the return of the robbed divine images, the punishment of Croesus and the protection of the sanctuaries of every city; although it is a political text serving the king's own legitimacy, it did open the Persian tradition of a monarch who shelters the temples of other gods and treats the conquered with restraint, and in 536 BC the statue of Marduk was brought back from Susa to Esagila, after which the priestly group of the two rivers worked with Persian kings for the long term. In institutions, the satrapy, the royal road with its relay of staging posts (Herodotus 5.52 describes the whole length of that relay system), and the Persian phalanx with its wicker shields were all copied later by the Greek and Hellenistic world. The last Assyrian king, Ashur-ubalit II, died at Harran in 609 BC; from then on the Assyrian spear survived only as heirloom and emblem, while the ironworkers and siegecraft of Assyria were absorbed by Persia. The costs and the unfinished business are just as clear: the grievances of the oppressed provinces did not die, the old Elamite royal house rose in Babylon in 521 BC and was put down at once, and Cyrus himself fell at the Zab in Central Asia in 530 BC, which pushed the frontier of empire out to Margiana and the steppes beyond.
result: 結果是波斯方全面勝利。西部行省與伊奧尼亞城邦在米利都陷落後歸附，呂底王克洛伊斯被俘後得居魯士禮遇，埃蘭在薩西斯一戰後失去獨立王權，特烏曼、坦馬里圖與烏馬尼什三名首領被俘；前539年新巴比倫在奧帕斯會戰崩潰後陷落，末代王納波尼德被擒而未受刑，貝爾沙爾陣亡。居魯士入巴比倫後在阿基圖祭受冊為王，以「萬國之王」自居，馬爾杜克神像歸還埃薩吉拉，埃蘭王室被安置在薩西斯，新巴比倫時代的宗教秩序就此終結，阿契美尼德王朝在兩河的統治由此開始。裝備層面也有一個清楚的斷點：亞述長矛所代表的制式軍備在九尼微陷落後已隨亞述帝國一同退場，居魯士軍中真正決定勝負的是複合弓、柳條大盾、長矛與短斧，以及亞述工匠傳下的築壩、築坡與引水工程。留下的伏線則是西線的希臘記恨與埃蘭的復辟之夢，前530年居魯士陣亡札卜河，中亞與地中海兩端同時失去緩衝，這些都留給了他的兒子岡比西斯與後繼者去收拾。
resultEn: The result was a complete Persian victory. The western satrapies and the Ionian cities submitted after the fall of Miletus; Croesus was taken and treated well by Cyrus; Elam lost its independent kingship after the battle at Susa, with Teumman, Tammar and Umanish in captivity; and in 539 BC Neo-Babylon collapsed after the battle of Opis, the last king Nabonidus being captured and not punished, while Belshazzar fell in the fighting. Cyrus was installed as king at Babylon in the Akitu festival, took the title of king of all lands, returned the statue of Marduk to Esagila, settled the Elamite royal family at Susa, and so the religious order of the Neo-Babylonian age came to an end and Achaemenid rule over the two rivers began. On the level of equipment there is a clear break: the standard armament represented by the Assyrian spear had left the field with the Assyrian state after the fall of Nineveh, and what actually decided the fighting in Cyrus's host was the composite bow, the wicker shield, the long spear, the short axe, and the dams, ramps and diverted channels inherited from Assyrian engineers. The loose ends left behind were the Greek grudge in the west and the Elamite dream of restoration, and when Cyrus fell at the Zab in 530 BC the empire lost its buffer at once in Central Asia and in the Mediterranean; his son Cambyses and his successors were left to clear that up.
